Two commits: the edit and the `origin/main` merge at `a251aaa19` (the merge base = `origin/main` at the seat's fetch).

The leg is gated on the CHECKOUT, not on the job — which is exactly what the sentence now says.
- **(c) The two lines paid — provable duplicates with named survivors.** `AGENTS.md` is 1116 / 1116 (headroom 0; widest table row 768 / 768) and the corrected clause is longer, so two sentences went: (1) 「A prop both sides declare and no renderer reads is, to this gate, perfect agreement.」 — the middle term between the paragraph's bold opening (「compares two DECLARATIONS, not a declaration against an implementation」) and the next sentence (「don't read it as proof anything renders」), which together state it; the fuller copy stands at `packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts` :18; (2) 「written by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` beside」 — the generator name, carried at `AGENTS.md` :158 with the full invocation and the `--objectui-version` flag this copy never had. The ceiling was not raised; no re-wrap bought a line. (The dev also named ADR-0082 :129 as a carrier of (1); the seat reads that line as a different sentence — the script comment is the carrier.)
- **(d) Item 2 — the sibling sweep is measured, and the ruling's own illustration is falsified.** The grep the ruling prescribes returns 23 hits at `4fba5036f` across three files (`ci.yml` contributes none): `AGENTS.md` :765 is the one over-claim; :159 is the pin-bump instruction (check 3, offline, true); the script's 19 hits and `lint.yml` :892 / :6665 tell the truth; a wider `git grep` finds four more prose carriers (`docs/releases-maintenance.md`, `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts`) all already narrow. ⚠️ Ruling item 1 names two places the version-vs-pin leg runs — the pin bump and the advisory console-build job — and the dev measured that NEITHER invokes the gate (the console-pin job runs `build-console.sh` / `check:console-sha` / `check:console-injection`; `bump-objectui.sh` tells the operator the lint job will red the bump PR, which is check 3), and `--require-objectui` has zero callers on the tree. The landed sentence therefore states the ruling's core (「runs only where an objectui checkout is in hand」) and omits the enumeration: writing it would have replaced one over-claim with another. The seat concurs — the core obligation is executed, the illustration is a fact for the maintainer's eye at merge, ⛔ not a deviation from the ruling's decision.
